name: assign_cases
description: Assign the learner a case trainer session focused on one case or rule: focus = a case id (imenovalnik, rodilnik, dajalnik, tozilnik, mestnik, orodnik) or a rule id (the grammar page: rodilnik-predlogi, rodilnik-nikalnica, rodilnik-kolicina, kam-tozilnik, kje-mestnik-orodnik, dajalnik, orodnik, tozilnik, mestnik, skloni), with a one-line note in the learner's base. Home and the trainer offer it until a session with that focus is played (cases_done says so); focus null takes it back.

focus.description: A case id or a rule id; null takes the assignment back

note.description: Why, in a line (shown with it)
